films.title: The front desk that always answers
films.story: One weekday call to a busy dental practice: answered, qualified, booked only after the calendar confirms, and visible to the team.

scenes.narration: It's Tuesday morning. The front desk is with a patient, and the phone rings again.
scenes.visual: Shot dental-hero: slow forward dolly down an empty daylit dental corridor. Small ivory time stamp fades in: Tue 10:40 am. Small corner label: Illustrative demonstration.

scenes.narration: This time, it's answered straight away. The receptionist greets the caller in the practice's name, listens, and works out what they need.
scenes.visual: Clean vector call card slides in over the corridor: Incoming call, then Answered. A thin gold line traces from the card towards the right of frame, starting the handoff path.

scenes.narration: A new patient, a chipped tooth, mornings only. It asks what your team would ask: the kind of visit, how soon, which times suit, and checks the answers against the practice's rules.
scenes.visual: Three answers settle into the card one at a time as short typeset rows: New patient. Chipped tooth. Mornings. A small tag, Practice rules applied, ticks on after the third row.

scenes.narration: Then it checks the calendar. Only when the calendar confirms the slot does it say booked. Thursday, nine fifteen. Confirmed.
scenes.visual: Gold line runs to a minimal week calendar. Status reads Checking calendar, pauses, then the Thursday 9:15 slot fills and the badge changes to Confirmed by calendar. The word Booked appears only after the badge.

scenes.narration: At the desk, the team can see it all: who called, why, what was booked, and a short summary, without stopping what they're doing.
scenes.visual: Line continues to a simple team view: caller, reason, confirmed booking and a two-line summary. Generous spacing, no invented metrics or staff names.

scenes.narration: And it works the way your practice does. Every call, or just overflow. Business hours, after hours, or alongside your staff. You choose.
scenes.visual: A single 24-hour bar with four labelled settings lighting in turn: All calls, Alongside staff, After hours, Overflow. Each setting holds long enough to read.

scenes.narration: Before anything goes live, we set up and test your booking, your call routing and your texts. Booking systems vary, so we confirm yours first.
scenes.visual: Three-line checklist ticks in sequence: Booking tested, Routing tested, Texts tested. Beneath, one short readable line: Booking-system compatibility varies; we confirm yours during setup.

scenes.narration: M&U Ventures. An all-hours front desk for your business. Book a fifteen-minute demo.
scenes.visual: Shot mu-brand-loop: gold light moving across black architectural material. M&U logo and Book a 15-minute demo typeset in the negative space during editing.

films.title: From enquiry to a useful handoff
films.story: A homeowner's selling enquiry on a Sunday evening becomes one structured handoff for an estate agent, with the request clearly recorded and nothing falsely booked.

scenes.narration: It's Sunday evening. A homeowner is thinking about selling, and they ring the agency they drove past this morning.
scenes.visual: Shot property-hero: restrained lateral glide across an unbranded residential interior. Small time stamp: Sun 7:20 pm. Small corner label: Illustrative demonstration.

scenes.narration: The receptionist answers in the agency's name. It's friendly, it listens, and it keeps the conversation on track.
scenes.visual: Vector call card appears over the interior: Incoming call, then Answered. Card styling follows the agency concept palette, not M&U black and gold.

scenes.narration: It gathers what an agent actually needs: the suburb, the kind of home, when they're hoping to sell, and the best way to get back to them.
scenes.visual: A structured form fills field by field: Suburb, Property type, Timing, Preferred contact. Values are generic placeholders, never a real address.

scenes.narration: Then it's straight with the caller. Their request is recorded. Nothing is booked yet, and no one has promised a price or a time.
scenes.visual: Two status rows side by side. Request recorded: lit with a tick. Appointment booked: visibly empty and labelled Not booked. No valuation figure appears anywhere.

scenes.narration: When the agent next checks in, there's one tidy handoff waiting, not a vague voicemail: who called, about which property, how soon, and what they asked.
scenes.visual: The form collapses into a single handoff card that travels along a line into the agency team view. Card fields: caller, suburb, timing, questions asked, status Request recorded.

scenes.narration: If your calendar is connected and tested, it can book the meeting too. If not, it records the request, and says so.
scenes.visual: Split frame. Left: Calendar connected and tested, then Confirmed by calendar. Right: No calendar connected, then Request recorded. Equal visual weight.

scenes.narration: Every enquiry, turned into a useful next step. Book a fifteen-minute demo with M&U Ventures.
scenes.visual: Shot mu-brand-loop with M&U logo and Book a 15-minute demo typeset in the negative space during editing.

shots.purpose: Opening shot of the main receptionist film and hero loop of the dental website preview.
shots.prompt: Empty contemporary dental practice, reception opening into a treatment corridor. Eye-level framing, centred one-point perspective, corridor leading towards soft window light. Materials: pale oak joinery, matte white walls, warm limestone floor, brushed stainless details, one green plant. Light: clear Australian morning daylight through large windows, soft natural shadows, neutral white balance. Camera: one slow, steady forward dolly of about one metre, no cuts, no shake. Realistic photographic look, 35mm lens, readable depth of field.
negativeRequirements: No people, patients or staff
No dental treatment, instruments in use or clinical procedures
No logos, brand marks, readable signage or text
No lens flare, glow effects or particles
No warped or distorted architecture

shots.purpose: M&U end card and brand background; typography is added during editing.
shots.prompt: Abstract architectural close-up: warm metallic gold light slowly sweeping across a near-black surface of fluted stone or brushed black metal. The left two-thirds of the frame stay dark and calm as negative space for typography. Colour: deep black near #08090b with restrained gold highlights near #c7a35a. Camera: locked off or an almost imperceptible drift; the motion comes from the light. Photographic material realism.

No robot heads, faces, figures or generic AI imagery
No particle clouds, bokeh, sparks or lens flares
